selection_rule: Exactly three evaluated responses required. 1/3 or 2/3 all-case passes: mixed, eligible for priority family selection; 3/3: ceiling, exclude from primary selection; 0/3: floor, diagnose specification/oracle and failure before any future simplification. Missing/infrastructure/not-evaluated: incomplete, no classification. No model retries or outcome-driven edits. If no mixed family emerges, do not pretend calibration succeeded: document floors/ceilings and make third pilot conditional on a new separately frozen calibration.
primary_outcome: All predefined cases pass for a generated function; candidate syntax/runtime/timeout/format errors count as failure. Infrastructure and missing records excluded from evaluated counts and reported.
secondary_outcome: Cases passed when observable; execution errors abort batch, so passed=0 does not measure individual preceding cases.
purpose: Exploratory task-difficulty calibration with one prompt per task. No estimate of prompt sensitivity. Selection applies to task families; new input values alone are not held-out programming tasks.
order: Frozen randomized dispatch order, at most three in flight.
freeze_policy: Freeze all prompts, tasks, references, cases, generator, protocol, schedule, runner and grader before dispatch. Exclude rather than silently fix a task found invalid after outcomes; publish the defect and new round if needed.
evidence_limits: Requested model/effort not provider-confirmed serving revision
No inherited conversation but system instructions/tools/shared filesystem remain
Full tool traces and sampling seed/temperature unavailable
First final copied unchanged; timestamps are coordinator observations
Finite-case ordinary-code grader, not adversarial interpreter security
analysis: Report each task separately. Three repeats only screen observed difficulty; classifications do not establish population accuracy. Do not pool calibration with prompt-variation pilots. Design a third pilot but do not collect it in this workstream.
